description: Parc régional annuel de production éolien et solaire is a dataset listed in Open Data Région Pays de la Loire, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by RTE. Parc de production éolien et solaire (MW) au 31 décembre en région des Pays de la Loire, depuis 2001. Coverage: Pays de la Loire. The portal files it under Territoires. Its keywords are EnR, Bilan annuel, Parc, TEO. The portal shows 25 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2018-11-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-paysdelaloire-fr-portal.
